entries.name: Change in Corporate Cash Holdings
entries.rule: After filing publication, long top quintile positive cash-holdings change; filter cash-rich firms; rebalance quarterly
entries.params: sector neutral; minimum ADV; filing availability lag; 12-month hold sensitivity
entries.risk: financing events, mergers, reporting lags, cash-rich interaction
entries.overlap: QSI-101 balance sheet NOA; QSI-108 asset growth; different change-in-cash mechanism
entries.evidence: Positive change in cash holdings predicts higher risk-adjusted returns, concentrated outside cash-rich firms; abstract does not give deployable Sharpe.

entries.name: Patent-Based Innovative Efficiency
entries.rule: Rank within industry on patent output per R&D; long top quintile, review low quintile as benchmark
entries.frequency: annual patents and filings; monthly rebalance
entries.params: lag patent publication; citation vintage; 3-year R&D normalization; liquidity filters
entries.risk: patent publication delay, citation look-ahead, patent data licensing, industry concentration
entries.overlap: QSI-102 organization capital; different innovation-output efficiency rather than SG&A stock
entries.evidence: Paper finds patent/citation efficiency positively predicts subsequent returns after controls; no verified net Sharpe.

entries.name: Employee Satisfaction Intangible Premium
entries.signal: 1 if included in contemporaneously published best-employer list else 0
entries.rule: Long publicly ranked firms after release; benchmark industry and market matched portfolios; annual update
entries.params: publication timestamp, survivorship-free constituents, industry neutrality, 12-month hold
entries.risk: ranking licensing, list survivorship, employer selection bias, high overlap with quality
entries.overlap: QSI-102 organization capital; human satisfaction ranking is distinct observed intangible
entries.evidence: Historical 1984–2009 annual four-factor alpha 3.5% reported in paper, not net current Sharpe.

entries.name: Advertising-Induced Attention Reversal
entries.signal: change in advertising / sales (or timestamped ad campaign intensity)
entries.rule: Research high advertising-surprise names as risk filter; compare 1, 3, 12-month forward returns, no automatic short
entries.frequency: quarterly spend or daily licensed ad data
entries.params: lag ad expense filings; control sales growth and momentum; no borrow-dependent production
entries.risk: reverse causality, publication delays, borrow fees, contradictory evidence
entries.overlap: QSI-078 sentiment-conditioned equity; firm advertising-induced attention differs from aggregate sentiment
entries.evidence: Lou 2014 finds temporary attention-related price rise then reversal; 2019 RFS paper DOI 10.1093/rfs/hhz142 disputes short-term price effect.

entries.name: Year-End Tax-Loss Selling Rebound
entries.rule: After December selling window, study liquid prior losers for early January rebound; enforce calendar and tax regime
entries.params: exclude illiquid penny stocks; prior 11-month loss; December last trading days and January exit window
entries.risk: tax regime shifts, January effect decay, spreads, year-end liquidity, seasonal data mining
entries.overlap: QSI-084 turn-of-month and QSI-094 same-month seasonality; tax-driven loss realization is different economic mechanism
entries.evidence: 1983 paper links December tax-motivated sales and January recovery, strongest in small caps; no current costed Sharpe.
